title: Agent masked inpaint comes back at the ratio size, not the source size
description: Live 2026-09-29: agent klein-9b inpaint on a 1920x1080 snapshot returned 1344x768. modelShowsRatio ignores the op's components, so the agent injects Width/Height on ops the UI never offers a ratio (inpaint everywhere; detail/upscale on Klein; edit on Boogu and cloud editors; pid).
